AUTHOR: A. S. Srikanth
TITLE: Real-Time Background-Agnostic Fish Localization in Underwater Videos towards Autonomous Species Monitoring
REGION: Tweed River estuary and Tallebudgera Creek, SE Queensland, Australia; Ipswich Mills Dam fish ladder, Massachusetts, USA
SPECIES: luderick, Australian bream (Seagrass); river herring Alosa pseudoharengus / A. aestivalis (IRWA); class-agnostic fish masks
DATA: Luderick Seagrass dataset (Ditria et al., 4,281 frames) + IRWA fish-ladder monitoring camera (10 videos, ~1,200 manually labelled frames)
V_EV: Sec. V: 'the noise level was high, and the illumination was not so good as Seagrass.'
D_EV: Sec. IV-A: 'all of the 4,281 frames were used for either one of training, validation, or testing.'
R_EV: Sec. V: SUIM-Net 'was trained one-time with 2,200 already annotated fish images from the Seagrass dataset. It was not re-trained with manually labeled IRWA frames'; Table I F-score 81.25 vs 31.65
E_EV: Table I: 'VALIDATION ACCURACY: F-SCORE AND MEAN INTERSECTION OVER UNION (MIOU)' only
ARCH: Ensemble (soft/weighted voting) of SuBSENSE background subtraction, fine-tuned SUIM-Net (binary), RLOF optical flow
NOTE: External: SUIM-Net trained only on Seagrass and applied to IRWA fishway camera (different region, camera, habitat) -> R1=Y, R2=복수, R3=Y (Table I per-dataset F-score/mIoU). Weighted-voting weights were trained on labelled IRWA frames, so the ensemble itself is not fully external. Split unit/ratio not stated -> D1 NR; reported metrics are 'validation accuracy'. NIMG = 4,281 + ~1,200. PRE: SUIM-Net pre-trained weights (SUIM underwater dataset) for first two encoder layers. IRWA camera has infrared lights for night recording (not used as stratum).
